speaker: penny
text: Ew, stop it, no, leave me alone.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Who's running the red Corvette?

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: That would be me.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: You know, in the future, when we're disembodied brains in jars, we're going to look back on this as eight hours well wasted.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: I don't want to be in a jar. I want my brain in an android body. Eight feet tall and ripped.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: I' m with you. I just have to make sure if I' m a synthetic human I'd still be Jewish. I promised my mother.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: I suppose you could have your android penis circumcised. But that's something your Rabbi would have to discuss with the manufacturers.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Not to mention you'd have to power down on Saturdays.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Sheldon, why is this letter in the trash?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Well, there's always the possibility that a trash can spontaneously formed around the letter, but Occam's Razor would suggest that someone threw it out.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: It's from the Institute for Experimental Physics. They want us to present our paper on the properties of super solids at the topical conference on Bowes- Einstein condensates.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I know. I read it before I threw it out.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Okay... if I may drill down to the bedrock of my question, why did you throw it out.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Because I have no interest in standing in the Rose Room of the Pasadena Marriott in front of a group of judgmental strangers, who wouldn't recognize true genius if it were standing in front of them giving a speech. Which, if I were there, it would be.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: I don't know, Sheldon, those topical conferences on Bowes- Einstein condensates parties are legendary.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Forget the parties.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Forget the parties? What a nerd.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Are there any other honors I' ve gotten that I don't know about? Did UPS drop off a Nobel Prize with my name on it?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Leonard, please don't take this the wrong way, but the day you win a Nobel Prize, is the day I begin my research on the drag co- efficient of tassles on flying carpets.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Hoo- hoo- hoo. The only thing missing from that insult was' yo mamma.'

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: I' ve got one, hey Leonard, your mamma's research methodology is so flawed...

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Shut up, Howard. Sheldon, we have to do this.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: No we don't. We have to take in nourishment, expel waste, and inhale enough oxygen to keep ourselves from dying, everything else is optional.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Okay, let me put it this way, I' m doing it.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: You can't. I' m the lead author.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Oh, come on. The only reason you're the lead author is because we went alphabetically.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I let you think we went alphabetically to spare you the humiliation of dealing with the fact that it was my idea. Not to put too fine a point on it, but I was throwing you a bone. You're welcome.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Excuse me, I designed the experiment that proved the hypothesis.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: It doesn't need proving.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: So the entire scientific community is just supposed to take your word?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: They're not supposed to, but they should.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Alright, I don't care what you say, I' m going to the conference and I' m presenting our findings.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: And I forbid it.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: You forbid it?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: If I' m not taking credit for our work then nobody is.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Oh, you admit that it's our work.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: No, once again, I' m throwing you a bone. And once again, you are welcome.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Ah!

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Oh no he dit'nt!
